policies.fixed: tool argument wins; otherwise AGVM_MCP_BRAIN_ID or active/default local MCP config brain is injected
policies.ai_resolve_existing: no UI active brain is injected; AI must call list_brains or ensure_brain with create_if_missing=false, then pass the chosen brain_id
policies.ai_create_if_missing: no UI active brain is injected; AI must call ensure_brain with create_if_missing=true and activation_policy=return_only, then pass the returned brain_id

hosted_scope.policy: tenant_id and user_id let the API resolve the hosted default brain when no local brain_id is provided

environment.AGVM_MCP_BRAIN_POLICY: Optional brain policy: fixed, ai_resolve_existing, or ai_create_if_missing
environment.AGVM_MCP_BRAIN_ID: Optional override for active/default brain id
environment.AGVM_MCP_BRAIN_ID_HINT: Optional stable brain id hint used by ensure_brain in AI-managed policies
environment.AGVM_MCP_BRAIN_DISPLAY_NAME: Optional display name injected into ensure_brain in AI-managed policies
environment.AGVM_MCP_BRAIN_PURPOSE: Optional purpose injected into ensure_brain in AI-managed policies
environment.AGVM_MCP_TENANT_ID: Optional hosted tenant id for managed or hosted-dev scope
environment.AGVM_MCP_USER_ID: Optional hosted user id for default-brain resolution
environment.AGVM_MCP_READ_ONLY: Optional true/false override for mutation tool execution; tools remain visible and blocked calls return structured reasons
environment.AGVM_MCP_BLOCKED_PERMISSION_FAMILIES: Optional comma-separated override such as explicit_apply,destructive
environment.AGVM_MCP_MODULE_VISIBILITY_POLICY: Optional module tool visibility policy: metadata_only, hide_unlicensed, or block_unlicensed. The public Core default keeps the current runtime catalog discoverable and blocks unlicensed paid-module calls before API execution.
environment.AGVM_MCP_LOCAL_LICENSE_PATH: Optional explicit path to agvm_local_license.json; defaults to AGVM_LAB_DATA_DIR/agvm_local_license.json inside the API container

policies.metadata_only: Do not enforce local module leases; expose registry metadata only.
policies.hide_unlicensed: Hide module-required tools from tools/list and block direct calls when the local lease is missing, invalid, expired or lacks that module.
policies.block_unlicensed: Keep the current runtime catalog visible for discoverability but block direct module-required calls before API execution when the local lease is missing, invalid, expired or lacks that module.

permission_families.read_only: Safe read tools and guide calls
permission_families.read_only_export: Read tools that may return larger exported packages
permission_families.preview_only: Preview memory formation or maintenance without applying
permission_families.explicit_apply: Apply memory writes, grow, sleep, evolve or calibration after approval
permission_families.destructive: Delete/restore/destructive admin operations; blocked by default
